source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. The void king reveals itself: unsettling and void-like, a blank page tearing, with brief hushed breaks between phrases that never fully stop the pulse. Tempo 132 BPM, 4/4 time, key of B minor. Instrumentation: dissonant celesta and bell clusters, low drums, bowed metal textures, deep strings, sub pulses. Form: eerie intro, pulsing section, hushed break, pulsing section again. Duration: 65 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
